query_snapshot: Which alloy and heat-treatment conditions does NASA SP-8119 identify as susceptible to stress corrosion in its material-compatibility discussion?
final_answer:
Evidence-grounded answer:

- NASA SP-8119 states: "Materials Susceptible to stress corrosion should not be used." [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- NASA SP-8119 lists 2014-T4 as an alloy/heat-treatment condition susceptible to stress corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- NASA SP-8119 lists 2024 in the standard heat-treated conditions T3, T4, and T351 as susceptible to stress corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- NASA SP-8119 lists PH15-7Mo in the conditions RH950 and TH1050 as susceptible to stress corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- NASA SP-8119 lists 17-7PH in the annealed condition and H900 condition as susceptible to stress corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- NASA SP-8119 lists 17-4PH in the conditions RH950 and TH1050 as susceptible to stress corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- NASA SP-8119 lists AM350 SCT850 and AM355 SCT850 as alloy/heat-treatment entries identified as susceptible to stress corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
